Springbank 15 Year Old – Review

Bottled at 46% vol, the Springbank 15 is matured mainly in sherry casks. Few distilleries make whisky the way Springbank does: floor maltings, everything on site.

Nose: dried fruit, brine, a whiff of smoke. Palate: oily, leather, toffee.

This is a whisky I keep coming back to. Score: 89/100.
